The crypto bug is fixed via mkId() helper at /app/frontend/src/utils/id.ts. On web preview, expo-image-picker uses a hidden <input type=file>, and Playwright's expect_file_chooser() correctly intercepts it — this is the pattern used to end-to-end test image uploads. rca_of_issue: RCA (confirmed fixed): the previous impl called `crypto.randomUUID?.()` at module top-level scope, which threw `Property 'crypto' doesn't exist` on React Native (iOS/Android) because RN's global scope has no `crypto` binding — only web/browser environments do. The fix wraps the lookup in try/catch on `globalThis.crypto` and falls back to a Math.random-based UUID string. Both branches were exercised: the web preview run above went through the `crypto.randomUUID()` branch (browser has it) and produced a valid uuid used as the MediaFile.id, which then rendered a functional remove button — proving state append succeeded. On native, the try/catch fallback path would return a valid v4-ish string with no reference to `crypto`, eliminating the runtime error.
